title: Require active internet connection (disable offline/public offline play)

requirements.text: Enforce an online-only restriction so the Traffic Jam game cannot be played without an active internet connection (offline play must be blocked).

quotes: Aap ismein yah future shamil Karen ki yah online ke Bina isko Koi public khel na sake

acceptanceCriteria: If the device is offline, the app does not allow starting or continuing gameplay and instead shows a blocking UI stating that an internet connection is required.
If the connection drops while the app is open, gameplay is immediately blocked and the user is prompted to reconnect.
When the connection is restored, the user can proceed back into the game without a full manual reset (e.g., a clear retry / continue action or auto-unblock).

requirements.text: Modify the PWA service worker behavior to prevent the app/game from functioning offline (do not cache game assets for offline use), while still allowing a dedicated offline page to appear when navigation occurs without network connectivity.

quotes: online ke Bina ... khel na sake

acceptanceCriteria: When offline, navigation requests resolve to the existing offline page (offline.html).
When offline, game JS/assets are not served from cache in a way that enables gameplay.

After installing the PWA and loading the game once, turning on airplane mode prevents gameplay and shows the offline blocking experience (either the offline page on reload or the in-app blocker if already open).

requirements.text: Update the in-app Help/About content to explicitly state (in English) that Traffic Jam requires an active internet connection and does not support offline play.

quotes: online ke Bina ... khel na sake

acceptanceCriteria: The Help/About panel includes a clear English sentence indicating the game requires an internet connection and offline play is not available.
No non-English user-facing text is introduced for this change.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components must be composed, not edited).
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor; do not add additional backend services.
nonGoals: Adding user accounts, Internet Identity login, or online leaderboards.
Publishing an APK/AAB or Play Store submission work.
